question.worked_solution:
First, we move all of the terms to the left-hand side and then factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}6{x}^{2}+2x-2 & =8{x}^{2}-x-2 \\ 6{x}^{2}+2x-2-(8{x}^{2}-x-2) & =0 \\ 6{x}^{2}+2x-2-8{x}^{2}+x+2 & =0 \\ (6{x}^{2}-8{x}^{2})+(2x+x)+(-2+2) & =0 \\ -2{x}^{2}+3x+0 & =0 \\ -2{x}^{2}+3x & =0 \\ x(-2x+3) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

So, by the zero product rule, we have

$$
x=0 \qquad\text{or}\qquad -2x + 3=0,
$$

which in turn gives 

$$
x=0 \qquad\text{or}\qquad x=\dfrac{3}{2}.
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $x=0,\dfrac{3}{2}.$
